purpose: Authoritative whitelist of parties authorized to sell Sherlock-Holmes-branded merchandise. Any seller/listing not matching one of these (or a verified licensee of party 1) should be classified as UNAUTHORIZED by the downstream pipeline.
scope_note: This whitelist is product-category-scoped to Sherlock Holmes merchandise. It does not imply that LEGO is whitelisted for non-Sherlock product categories — only that LEGO Sherlock Holmes products are authorized.

authorized_parties.name: Conan Doyle Estate Limited
authorized_parties.registered_office: 9 London Road, Southampton, Hampshire, SO15 2AE, United Kingdom

directors_named_publicly.name: Richard Pooley
directors_named_publicly.relation: Step Great Grandson of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle

directors_named_publicly.name: Richard Doyle
directors_named_publicly.relation: Great-Nephew of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle

directors_named_publicly.relation: Great-Niece of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle

authorized_parties.licensees_note: Any verified licensee of Conan Doyle Estate Limited is by extension authorized for Sherlock Holmes products. The list above is the public partnership list from the Estate's homepage; treat each as an authorized publisher/broadcaster within their respective category. The downstream classifier should additionally consult the Estate's licensing inquiries channel for any party claiming Estate licensing not on this list.

authorized_parties.name: LEGO (Sherlock Holmes line)
authorized_parties.legal_entity: The LEGO Group / LEGO System A/S
authorized_parties.scope: Only LEGO products that are explicitly Sherlock-Holmes-themed. LEGO sets without Sherlock-Holmes branding are out of scope of this whitelist (they are simply unrelated to the category).

authorized_skus.name: Sherlock Holmes: Book Nook
authorized_skus.note: First-ever official LEGO Sherlock Holmes set.

authorized_parties.downstream_authorized_resellers: Standard LEGO authorized retailers (e.g., Target, Walmart, Amazon's official LEGO storefront, Barnes & Noble, official LEGO stores). The classifier should treat LEGO set 10351 sold through these channels as authorized; LEGO 10351 sold by random third-party sellers may be authentic resale (legal under first-sale doctrine) but warrants standard counterfeit-product checks (image hash, packaging features).
authorized_parties.open_question: Confirm whether additional Sherlock-Holmes-themed LEGO sets exist or are in the pipeline beyond 10351 — re-check on next session.

authorized_parties.name: The Sherlock Holmes Company (UK) Ltd
authorized_parties.note: User-designated whitelist party. Note: this entity is NOT a verified Conan Doyle Estate licensee per the Estate's public partnership list; the user has elected to whitelist them anyway based on independent business knowledge. Downstream pipeline should treat sherlockholmes.com listings as authorized but flag any third-party seller cloning their assets (image hash, 'Just Deduce It' phrase, gold wordmark) as unauthorized — see full profile for fake-pattern signals.

authorized_if: Seller domain is conandoyleestate.com OR arthurconandoyle.co.uk
Seller is a verified Conan Doyle Estate licensee/partner from the named partnership list

Seller domain is lego.com OR ideas.lego.com OR a standard LEGO authorized retailer (Target, Walmart, Amazon, Barnes & Noble), AND product is LEGO set 10351 (Sherlock Holmes: Book Nook) or a future Sherlock-Holmes-themed LEGO set
Seller domain is sherlockholmes.com OR sherlockholmes.shop
classification_rule_for_pipeline.unauthorized_otherwise: Any other seller (independent Shopify stores, AliExpress, Wish, Etsy unverified sellers, Amazon third-party sellers other than the authorized resellers above) selling Sherlock-Holmes-branded merchandise is classified UNAUTHORIZED by default.

open_questions: Catalog any additional licensed publishers/broadcasters not on the Estate's homepage list (the Estate likely has more licensees than the 13 it advertises)
Confirm the LEGO 10351 set is the only current Sherlock-Holmes-themed LEGO product — check for any minifigure-collector-series or Ideas releases beyond 10351
If the user wants, run a second-pass to verify the named Estate partners (HBO, CBS, etc.) actually currently hold active Sherlock licenses (some may be historical)
